content:
maria: Quick q — do we want 'entitlement' precedence higher than region routing for free accounts? I'm seeing free users get routed to cpu-fallback model in eu-west unexpectedly.
aj: Hmm I thought region should win. Are you seeing soft-eviction or hard fallback?
maria: Soft — requests hit capacity then routed to best-compatible variant. For free plan I want policy that prefers cheapest variant but stays region-local if available.
elena: We added 'entitlement' to policy last sprint to allow pro/ent override of geo. Maybe it bumped precedence.
sam: Suggestion: evaluation order = explicit_route -> region -> entitlement -> default. That keeps region first and still allows entitlements to override when explicitly set.
maria: That makes sense. But we also need quota enforcement before routing to avoid overcommit. If free plan has exhausted tokens in region, should we route to global pro pool? No.
aj: Right — quotas should gate before routing. Pseudocode: `if quota_exceeded(plan, region) then apply_plan_fallback(plan) else evaluate_routing()`
maria: Example config I'm imagining:
```json
{
  "priority_order": ["explicit_route","region","entitlement","default"],
  "quota_check_phase": "pre-routing",
  "fallback_map": {
    "free": ["cheap-variant","fallback-global"],
    "pro": ["pro-variant","cheap-variant"],
    "enterprise": ["enterprise-variant"]
  }
}
```
elena: Telemetry needs: tag every decision with `quota_stage` (pre/post) and `route_decision_reason` (region/entitlement/explicit/quota). That will help analysis.
ops-bot: alert configured: `quota_spike_free_eu` -> fires if >5% requests return quota_exceeded for plan=free, region=eu in 5m window.
sam: UX note: Console should surface a per-tenant "pre-routing quota hits" metric and an override toggle for enterprise only. Exposing toggle to free/pro is risky.
aj: Agreed. For enterprise we can enable `allow_fallback_to_dedicated` toggle (default off). Need audit log when used.
maria: I'll draft an RFC with the proposed eval order + pre-routing gating + telemetry. Owners: aj + elena. ETA EOD Thursday?
aj: I'm in. assigning to myself.
elena: I'll add telemetry bits and the alert details. :+1:
